speaker: seraphina
note: The title screen greeting — the first thing the game ever says. Spoken with a comma: edge-tts puts a full second of silence after a mid-line '!', which on screen is a second with no word lit. The comma keeps the beat without the dead air.

note: edge-tts reads any run of s's as the letter NAME, repeated: 'Sss' comes out 'ess ess ess'. 'Suh' at least leads with a real /s/. Placeholder until ElevenLabs — see the voice_pipeline_spike report.

note: Shown in capitals and spoken as a word: edge-tts reads a short run of capitals as letters, and 'R E A L' is not what he means. The say/text split keeps the emphasis on screen without spelling it aloud.
